doc: Audit table of JSON key-paths observed in adapter fixtures and what the corpus projection does with each. Path notation: dotted keys, '[]' marks an array step. Destination categories: 'projected:<column>' = lands in a typed column; 'preserved:<column>' = derived from this path into the column but the raw bytes also survive in entries.raw_json; 'raw_only:<reason>' = only in entries.raw_json (intentional v1 design or accepted gap). Adding a new fixture path that is not in this table fails TestKeyPathCoverage; the fix is to make the deliberate choice and record it here.

paths.message.content[].name: projected:messages.tool_name (tool_use)
paths.message.content[].input.file_path: raw_only:reachable via messages.files_json blob, not a typed column
paths.message.content[].input.pattern: raw_only:reachable via messages.files_json blob, not a typed column
paths.message.content[].id: raw_only:tool_use id, not projected in v1
paths.message.content[].tool_use_id: raw_only:tool_result link — tool_result bodies are now extracted into messages.text but the link id itself is not projected
paths.message.content[].content: projected:messages.text (tool_result body — gated by config.index_tool_output via shouldIndexText)
paths.message.content[].is_error: raw_only:tool_result error flag — future projection (analogous to OpenInference llm.finish_reason='error')
paths.fromId: raw_only:Pi branch_summary points to alternate-branch start — future column branch_from_entry_id
paths.name: raw_only:Pi session_info entry payload (session rename) — future projection
paths.message.api: raw_only:Pi message envelope (anthropic|openai selector). Discovered via pi-mono corpus.
paths.message.provider: raw_only:Pi message envelope provider — future messages.provider population (cross-agent-data-capture.md, column exists but unpopulated)
paths.message.stopReason: raw_only:Pi assistant stop reason — future projection (analogous to OpenInference llm.finish_reason)
paths.message.responseId: raw_only:Pi provider response id (Anthropic message_id / OpenAI response id) — future projection
paths.message.toolCallId: raw_only:Pi result→call link (their tool_use_id). Parser does not project tool_result linkage in v1 (parser.go:121).
paths.message.truncated: raw_only:Pi truncation marker on truncated outputs — see message.details.truncation.*
paths.message.command: raw_only:Pi BashExecutionMessage command field (separate from generic tool_use). Discovered via pi-mono corpus; Pi-native projection follow-up.
paths.message.output: raw_only:Pi BashExecutionMessage stdout. Discovered via pi-mono corpus.
paths.message.exitCode: raw_only:Pi BashExecutionMessage exit code. Discovered via pi-mono corpus.
paths.message.isError: raw_only:Pi error flag at message level. Generic parser only handles content[].is_error (also raw_only).
paths.message.fullOutputPath: raw_only:Pi spillover path when output is truncated to disk — see also message.details.fullOutputPath
paths.message.timestamp: raw_only:Pi message-envelope timestamp (redundant with entry.timestamp which is already projected)
paths.message.details: raw_only:Pi rich-details object wrapper — see sub-fields
paths.message.details.diff: raw_only:Pi diff text on edit/write entries — future projection
paths.message.details.fullOutputPath: raw_only:Pi spillover path inside details (variant of message.fullOutputPath)
paths.message.content[]: raw_only:empty Pi content array — no leaves; the path is recorded by walker for empty arrays
paths.message.content[].thinking: projected:messages.text (Pi 'thinking' block body; prepended so reasoning is searchable; via projectPiContentBlocks)
paths.message.content[].thinkingSignature: raw_only:Anthropic encrypted-thinking signature inside Pi thinking blocks
paths.message.content[].mimeType: projected:entry_assets.mime_type (Pi image content block top-level mimeType)
paths.message.content[].data: projected:entry_assets.data (Pi image content block top-level base64 data)
paths.message.content[].partialJson: raw_only:Pi streaming partial-JSON fragment captured mid-stream
paths.message.usage.input: projected:messages.tokens (Pi camelCase; summed when totalTokens absent; via projectPiUsage)
paths.message.usage.output: projected:messages.tokens (Pi camelCase; summed when totalTokens absent)
paths.message.usage.cost.input: raw_only:Pi per-category cost — only cost.total is projected (messages.cost); per-category split awaits dedicated columns
paths.message.usage.cost.output: raw_only:Pi per-category cost — future messages.cost_output column
paths.message.usage.cost.cacheRead: raw_only:Pi per-category cost — future messages.cost_cache_read column
paths.message.usage.cost.cacheWrite: raw_only:Pi per-category cost — future messages.cost_cache_write column
paths.message.usage.cost.total: projected:messages.cost (Pi precomputed total cost; via projectPiUsage)
paths.entrypoint: raw_only:Claude Code top-level invocation context (cli/web/etc). Discovered via claude-code-sample.
paths.gitBranch: raw_only:Claude Code top-level git context — future column (analogous to sessions.project_key)
paths.isSidechain: raw_only:Claude Code subagent flag at entry level — already surfaced via sessions.is_subagent at session level
paths.isSnapshotUpdate: raw_only:Claude Code snapshot-entry flag — entry classification not projected
paths.messageId: raw_only:Claude Code stable Anthropic message_id — future projection (analogous to Pi message.responseId)
paths.permissionMode: raw_only:Claude Code permission scope (acceptEdits/plan/etc.) — future projection
paths.promptId: raw_only:Claude Code per-prompt id — future projection
paths.requestId: raw_only:Claude Code provider request id — future projection
paths.sessionId: raw_only:Claude Code session id (matches sessions.source_session_id derivation but not at entry level)
paths.snapshot.messageId: raw_only:Claude Code snapshot wrapper (file-tracking) — entire snapshot stream is raw_only in v1
paths.snapshot.trackedFileBackups: raw_only:Claude Code snapshot wrapper (paths of backed-up files)
paths.message.type: raw_only:Claude Code message envelope discriminator (Anthropic 'message' vs other)
paths.message.stop_reason: raw_only:Claude finish reason — future projection (OpenInference llm.finish_reason)
paths.message.usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_1: raw_only:Anthropic prompt-cache TTL split (1h) — granular cache split lost; coarse total via existing cache_creation_input_tokens
paths.message.usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_5: raw_only:Anthropic prompt-cache TTL split (5m) — granular cache split lost
paths.payload.action.pattern: raw_only:Codex modern format wraps everything in payload. Parser expects top-level message.*; Codex modern uses payload.*. Codex-native projection follow-up (discovery parallels Pi's toolCall gap).
paths.payload.arguments: projected:messages.files_json + messages.command (Codex modern function_call arguments, including command/cmd variants)
paths.payload.call_id: raw_only:Codex modern function_call id (analogous to tool_use_id)
paths.payload.cli_version: raw_only:Codex modern session_meta — useful for version-correlated pathology detection
paths.payload.collaboration_mode.settings.reas: raw_only:Codex modern config (analogous to Pi thinkingLevel)
paths.payload.content: projected:messages.text (Codex modern message content; via projectCodexPayloadEnvelope)
paths.payload.content[].type: raw_only:Codex modern content block type discriminator (input_text/output_text)
paths.payload.cwd: projected:sessions.raw_cwd (Codex modern session_meta cwd, when top-level cwd absent)
paths.payload.encrypted_content: raw_only:Codex modern encrypted reasoning content (analogous to Anthropic encrypted_content)
paths.payload.id: raw_only:Codex modern per-entry id (different from top-level id)
paths.payload.images[]: raw_only:Codex modern image array (top-level), parser misses these
paths.payload.last_agent_message: raw_only:Codex modern compaction marker (analogous to Pi compaction.firstKeptEntryId)
paths.payload.model: projected:messages.model (Codex modern turn_context; carried forward to message entries)
paths.payload.name: projected:messages.tool_name (Codex modern function_call)
paths.payload.output: projected:messages.text (Codex modern function_call_output body; gated like other tool output)
paths.payload.rate_limits.credits: raw_only:Codex modern rate-limit tracking — useful for cost detection
paths.payload.summary: raw_only:Codex modern reasoning summary (analogous to Pi branch_summary)
paths.payload.timestamp: raw_only:Codex modern per-entry timestamp (redundant with top-level timestamp)
paths.payload.turn_id: raw_only:Codex modern turn id — future projection
paths.payload.type: raw_only:Codex modern inner-type discriminator (session_meta/user_input/agent_message/function_call/function_call_output/reasoning/rate_limits/token_count) — entries.entry_type captures the outer type only
